about: How each version's short is cut from its median measured run. start: 'first-key' (the bot's first key press: the game starts moving) or 'screen:<name>' (the first time that screen appears), optionally afterMs later (for a screen that fades in). segments: clip time in ms and the playback speed of the run during it (1 = real time). The whole clip is at most 30000 ms and must include the first apple.
